_comment: WP-36 (CLN-004): items scripts/cleanup/check.mjs reports as unreferenced but that must stay. Every entry needs a reason (at least 10 characters). files: { file, reason }; exports: { file, name, reason }; classes: { name | pattern (a regular expression), reason }. A stale entry (the item is gone or referenced again) is a warning: remove it. Ambient .d.ts files, test-only files and generated classes (a template or concatenation ending in prefix-) are kept by the scan itself and need no entry.
